beats.say: Dogs were the first species and only large carnivore ever domesticated.
This bond started long before humans ever began farming.
Genetic studies show dogs split from wolves between 20,000 and 40,000 years ago.
The evidence is hidden in the earth.
Skeletons found in Belgium and Siberia's Altai Mountains date back about 33,000 years.
This means your pet is the result of a prehistoric partnership that changed the world.
That was Animals Explained. Subscribe to discover more amazing creatures.
Do you think your dog still has a wolf's spirit?

facts: Dogs were the first species and only large carnivore ever domesticated.
Genetic divergence between the dog's ancestor and modern wolves occurred between 20,000 and 40,000 years ago.
The oldest known dog skeletons were found in the Altai Mountains of Siberia and a cave in Belgium, dated ~33,000 years ago.
